core_obligations: Settle the easy direction and the rank one case (proof lines 6698-6700): the only if direction is assumption (2), and if the complex has a single nonzero cohomology sheaf the if direction is assumption (1).

Reduce to a complex killed by the pullback (proof lines 6702-6716): define property (P) to be the condition that the maps c are isomorphisms, form the distinguished triangle given by the adjunction map, observe that the third term still has (P) by assumption (2) and the two out of three lemma, and that its pullback vanishes since epsilon^{-1} R epsilon_* = id.

Show a complex with (P) and vanishing pullback is zero (proof lines 6720-6754): for such a complex with H^i = 0 below n, the distinguished triangle of the blow-up square gives an exact sequence in degree n; assumption (1) makes H^n a tau-sheaf, while its tau-sheafification is the cohomology of the vanishing pullback, so H^n = 0.
proof_roadmap: Recall that the only if direction is hypothesis (2) and the one sheaf case is hypothesis (1).
Split an arbitrary complex off its epsilon-acyclic part with the adjunction triangle so that the remainder is killed by the pullback.
Prove that a complex satisfying the square condition with vanishing pullback has no cohomology, using the exact sequence in the lowest degree.
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes which bounded below complexes of modules on the finer site lie in the essential image of the derived pushforward along epsilon, by the requirement that the canonical maps attached to a family of commutative squares be isomorphisms (statement lines 6669-6695). The proof is a complete argument: after disposing of the trivial cases (proof lines 6698-6700) the author introduces property (P), factors an arbitrary complex through the adjunction triangle so that the remainder has vanishing pullback (proof lines 6702-6716), and then proves that a complex with (P) and vanishing pullback has no cohomology at all by producing, in the lowest degree where cohomology could live, an exact sequence in which assumption (1) and the vanishing of the pullback force the vanishing (proof lines 6720-6754). The non-formal content is the reduction to the pullback-acyclic case and the degree argument. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with each input named.
